# book.fijidash.com
# Fiji Dash — Real-Time Driver Dispatch Marketplace

> Fiji Dash books private airport transfers and tours across Fiji with real-time, automated driver dispatch: a guest requests a ride, real drivers get the job broadcast to them, and the first to accept is confirmed within seconds. Fixed, distance-based pricing shown before booking — no surge pricing, no negotiation required (a Flexible Fare option exists for guests who want to negotiate anyway).

## How Dispatch Works
1. Guest picks a destination (from 50+ pre-priced routes) or enters a custom address for a real-time distance-based quote.
2. Guest confirms the booking at the fixed fare shown.
3. The request is broadcast instantly to every registered, currently-online driver covering that pickup zone.
4. The first driver to accept is confirmed — this happens automatically, typically within minutes, not through manual dispatch or a call centre.
5. Guest is connected directly to their assigned driver.

## Coverage Zones
Nadi, Nadi Airport, Wailoaloa, Denarau, Sonaisali, Vuda Point, Lautoka, Momi Bay, Natadola, Sigatoka, Coral Coast, Pacific Harbour, Ba, Rakiraki, Suva, Nausori.

Sedan (up to 3 pax) / Minivan (up to 6 pax) / Minibus (up to 10 pax). Prices below are the "from" sedan fare unless noted — minivan and minibus pricing shown per route on the booking site.

The live booking site contains the current 50+ route inventory and pricing. Custom addresses not listed above get a real-time, distance-based quote at booking time via live routing — never a guessed or flat price.

## Dispatch Fleet
Registered, verified local Fijian drivers. Exact live driver count and average dispatch-confirmation time not yet published — check the booking site for current figures as the marketplace scales.
